blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — The Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission (PAOCC) is intensifying its nationwide campaign against foreign nationals who allegedly obtain Philippine birth certificates through questionable late birth registrations, following the discovery of more than 46,000 records flagged for possible fraud. PAOCC Undersecretary Benjamin Acorda Jr. said the agency, in coordination with the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), is reviewing the registrations covering the period from 2010 to 2023, when Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGOs) rapidly expanded in the country.
